title: Generation of neutron Bessel beams
abstract: Matter waves can exhibit structured wavefields analogous to those of light, offering new means of controlling the spatial and angular-momentum degrees of freedom of massive particles. Bessel beams are a fundamental class of structured waves that exhibit non-diffracting propagation, self-healing, and well-defined orbital angular momentum (OAM). Here, we experimentally realize neutron Bessel beams by imprinting a nanoscale conical phase gradient onto a neutron wavefront. By incorporating azimuthal phase gradients, we generate zeroth-, third-, and sixth-order Bessel beams, demonstrating direct control of both the OAM and radial structure of a massive particle. We also propose a neutron Bessel-grating interferometer, complementary to established optical and electron interferometric methods, in which varying the radial grating period by approximately 100 nm yields a controlled Gouy phase shift of $\pi$. These results establish neutron Bessel beams as a new platform for diffractive neutron focusing and provide an experimental foundation for theoretical studies of Bessel beams in neutron scattering, decay, and OAM characterization.

summaries.en: The paper experimentally generates neutron Bessel beams by imprinting nanoscale conical and azimuthal phase gradients on neutron wavefronts to controllably produce different OAM orders and radial structures, and it proposes a neutron Bessel-grating interferometer where tuning the radial grating period produces a controllable π Gouy phase shift.
summaries.zh: 本文通过在中子波前上施加纳尺度的锥形与方位相位梯度，实验实现了中子贝塞尔光束，并可调控其轨道角动量阶次及径向结构，同时提出一种中子贝塞尔光栅干涉仪，通过调节径向光栅周期约100纳米可实现可控的π戈伊相位偏移。

title: Raman-induced Kerr effect and heating in diamond
abstract: We fully characterize the polarization-dependent third-order nonlinear susceptibility in a diamond crystal using phase-sensitive nondegenerate pump-probe spectroscopy near 1~$\mu$m wavelength. Measuring the frequency-domain phase shift and amplitude change of the probe pulse as a function of polarization and probe wavelength allows direct extraction of the full anisotropic $\chi^{(3)}$ response, including the Raman contribution. We find that the polarization dependence of the two-beam coupling contribution for the Raman component differs from that predicted solely using one-beam selection rules. We measure a Kerr coefficient that is within the range of reported values in the literature, and our measured anisotropy parameters satisfy Kleinman symmetry, as expected. Our measured Raman polarizability agrees, after scaling for its dispersion, with a Brillouin-referenced measurement at 514.5~nm [Grimsditch and Ramdas, Phys. Rev. B \textbf{11}, 3139 (1975)], but is lower than measurements from absolute Raman cross sections. The same technique could be used to measure other materials with relatively high phonon frequencies, and it complements measurements of the Kerr contribution of low-frequency modes using impulsive stimulated Raman scattering (ISRS). When the pump-probe difference frequency matches the phonon resonance, Raman-enabled two-photon absorption occurs; we directly measure the resulting heat deposition in diamond using time-resolved beam deflection of a continuous-wave laser. The measurement technique demonstrated here is capable of precise absolute $\chi^{(3)}$ measurements and will enable quantitative stimulated Raman heating microscopy, with potential extensions to thermal conductivity metrology.

summaries.en: Using polarization-dependent nondegenerate pump–probe spectroscopy near 1 μm, the authors fully extract diamond’s anisotropic third-order susceptibility including Raman contributions, find polarization behavior differing from simple one-beam rules, verify Kerr anisotropy consistent with Kleinman symmetry, reconcile Raman polarizability with earlier Brillouin-referenced data, and directly measure phonon-resonant Raman heating via time-resolved beam deflection enabling quantitative stimulated Raman heating microscopy.
summaries.zh: 作者采用接近1 μm的偏振相关非简并泵-探测相位敏感谱法，完整提取钻石各向异性的三阶非线性易感度并包含拉曼贡献，发现拉曼部分的双束耦合偏振依赖与仅用单束选择定则预测不一致，验证Kerr各向异性满足Kleinman对称性，比较并解释拉曼极化率与既有Brillouin参照测量的对应关系，同时在泵-探差频与声子共振时通过时间分辨光束偏转直接测量由拉曼引起的热沉积，从而实现可定量的受激拉曼加热显微并具备用于热导率计量的潜力。

title: Time-Varying Medium from an Ensemble of Laser-Dressed Quantum Emitters
abstract: We propose a minimal quantum-mechanical model of a frequency dispersive, time-modulated medium that explicitly incorporates the pumping mechanism. It consists of a homogeneous ensemble of quantum emitters dressed by a pump laser. We analyze their dispersive, time-varying response to a perturbative probe field by deriving the macroscopic polarizability of the ensemble, and then solving Maxwell's equations via the Floquet formalism. This yields a rich band structure that departs from conventional analyses in which the modulation source is neglected, arising from the interplay between the dispersive polaritonic and time-varying responses. These results shed light on the role of the modulation source in time-varying media and pave the way toward realizing dispersive time-varying media from driven quantum-mechanical systems.

summaries.en: The paper presents a minimal quantum model of a frequency-dispersive, time-modulated medium formed by a pumped ensemble of laser-dressed quantum emitters, deriving its macroscopic polarizability and using Floquet-based Maxwell solutions to reveal a modulation-source–dependent band structure arising from the interaction of dispersive polaritonic and time-varying responses.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一个由泵浦得到的激光包裹（dress）量子发射体均匀集合构成的频率色散、时间调制介质的最小量子模型，推导其宏观极化率并用基于Floquet的麦克斯韦方程求解，揭示了由于色散极化子响应与时间变化响应相互作用而产生的、不同于忽略调制来源的常规分析的丰富能带结构，从而阐明调制源在时间变化介质中的作用并为由驱动量子系统实现色散时间变化介质奠定基础。

title: Strong Epsilon-Near-Zero Confinement and Interface-Controlled Dynamics in Inverse-Designed Transparent Conducting Oxide Cavities
abstract: Achieving optical modulation that is both strong and ultrafast remains a central challenge in time-varying photonics. Here, we theoretically demonstrate that combining inverse-designed cavities that utilize transparent conducting oxides (TCOs) operating at the epsilon-near-zero (ENZ) point with boundaries that support carrier transport can meet this requirement. This is achieved by leveraging ENZ-enhanced optical absorption and electron heating with interface-engineered carrier relaxation. A multilayer inverse-design framework, combined with a structural disorder-aware correction loop, is developed to preserve robust resonant absorption in ultrathin TCO films under realistic material disorder. Relative to conventional TCO cavity geometries, the inverse-designed structures exhibit stronger light confinement, greater electron temperature modulation, and markedly faster recovery. Beyond cavity design, interfacial barrier engineering and adjacent-layer doping emerge as effective degrees of freedom for co-designing spectral and temporal dynamics. Furthermore, our theoretical framework shows that the inverse-designed cavity supports richer oscillatory transmittance dynamics on the few-optical-cycle timescale compared to its single-film counterpart, with interfacial control enabling further temporal compression. The combined control of optical confinement and interfacial dynamics establishes inverse-designed TCO cavities as a viable platform for time-varying photonic media capable of supporting strong and ultrafast optical responses.

summaries.en: The paper theoretically shows that inverse-designed ENZ-based transparent conducting oxide cavities with interface-controlled carrier transport can provide robust, stronger light confinement, larger electron-temperature modulation, and faster recovery, enabling strong ultrafast optical modulation and richer few-cycle oscillatory transmittance dynamics despite realistic disorder.
summaries.zh: 论文在理论上表明，将基于ε近零（ENZ）的透明导电氧化物（TCO）逆向设计腔体与界面受控的载流子输运相结合，可在考虑真实材料无序的情况下实现更强的光限制、更大的电子温度调制幅度与更快的恢复速度，从而支持强且超快的光学调制，并产生更丰富的、跨少数光学周期的振荡透射动力学。

title: Residual Allan Stability under Periodic Auxiliary Ramsey Sampling
abstract: The timing of auxiliary Ramsey measurements can change the frequency stability associated with a drifting pulse shift at a fixed nominal Fisher-information rate for a constant shift. For periodic instantaneous observations of an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck shift with causal prediction between updates, we derive the exact residual covariance averaged over the update cycle and the corresponding Allan variance at arbitrary averaging times. Relative to a continuous Kalman reference at the same information rate, periodic estimation increases the cycle-averaged estimation-error variance, reduces the short-time residual Allan variance, and increases its long-time value. Its covariance decays more slowly at the origin and has a larger integral. We extend the result to instantaneous sensing of the sum of finitely many independent Ornstein-Uhlenbeck modes. Integrated observations preserve the short-time ordering for the scalar shift, and numerical calculations resolve the dependence of the crossover on window duration. A zero-order-hold comparison shows that the short-time ordering can change when the same estimator drives a different correction command. A three-level Ramsey model of coherent population trapping (CPT) maps the discriminator response to an effective information budget and illustrates how the dark times affect the choice of schedule.

summaries.en: The paper analyzes how periodic auxiliary Ramsey sampling with causal prediction affects residual stability and Allan variance for an Ornstein–Uhlenbeck pulse shift (and sums of multiple such modes), deriving exact cycle-averaged covariances and showing how discrete estimation changes short- vs long-time behavior, including extensions to integrated observations, zero-order-hold scheduling differences, and a CPT three-level Ramsey model linking dark times to effective information budgets.
summaries.zh: 本文研究了在脉冲漂移为Ornstein–Uhlenbeck过程时，采用带因果预测的周期性辅助Ramsey采样如何影响残余稳定性与Allan方差（并扩展到多个独立OU模的和），推导了更新周期的精确平均协方差并表明离散估计会改变短时与长时的行为，同时讨论了积分观测、零阶保持导致的调度差异以及用CPT三能级Ramsey模型将“暗时”映射到有效信息预算的影响。

title: The Bapat-Sunder eigenvalue conjecture fails over the reals
abstract: In 1986 Bapat and Sunder asked whether $\operatorname{per}(A)$ is the largest eigenvalue of $F_A=[a_{i,j}\operatorname{per}(A(i,j))]$ for every positive semidefinite Hermitian $A$, where $A(i,j)$ deletes row $i$ and column $j$. Drury disproved this over the complex field in 2018 and conjectured that the property holds for real positive semidefinite matrices. We disprove Drury's conjecture with a rank-$4$, $32\times32$ integer Gram matrix and an integer vector whose Rayleigh quotient exceeds $\operatorname{per}(A)$; verification uses integer arithmetic. Together, the two counterexamples resolve the Bapat-Sunder eigenvalue conjecture negatively over both fields. Counterexamples exist of every order $n\ge32$. As an application to quantum optics, the violation yields a $36$-mode orthogonal interferometer and a direction of relative arrival-time delays among $32$ photons with identical-variance Gaussian wave packets along which every sufficiently small nonzero delay increases the probability that all photons are detected within four designated output modes.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Combinatorics (math.CO); Rings and Algebras (math.RA)

summaries.en: The paper gives two explicit counterexamples—one over the complex field and a new real counterexample via a rank-4 32×32 integer Gram matrix—that show the Bapat-Sunder eigenvalue conjecture about permanents and eigenvalues fails over both reals and complexes, with consequences for quantum optics including a 36-mode orthogonal interferometer exhibiting an increased probability of detecting 32 photons in four outputs under small nonzero relative arrival-time delays.
summaries.zh: 本文给出两个反例（一个在复数域、一个在实数域，基于秩为4的32×32整数格拉姆矩阵），证明Bapat-Sunder关于“永久和特征值关系”的猜想在实数与复数两种情形下都不成立，并在量子光学中展示：该违例对应一个36模正交干涉仪，其中小的非零到达时间相对延迟会提高32个具有相同方差高斯波包的光子同时被探测到4个指定输出模式的概率。

title: Look Mum, No Hands! Quantum State Preparation without Time-Dependent Control
abstract: How much can be prepared with a quantum system whose Hamiltonian cannot be modulated in time? Common intuition suggests that the answer is not much. Without a knob to turn during the evolution, a system seems confined to a fixed trajectory through its state space, while time-dependent control can steer it almost anywhere. We put this intuition to the test by studying autonomous control, i.e., state preparation with a time-invariant Hamiltonian, where the only freedom lies in the static coupling strengths and the evolution time. We characterize basic mathematical properties of the autonomously reachable set and introduce two criteria of unreachability: a certificate that is cheap to evaluate and rigorously excludes that a target state can be reached for any choice of control parameters, and a stronger criterion based on exhaustive numerical optimization. With these tools we estimate the probability that a typical state in Hilbert space is unreachable under randomly drawn control terms. The dimensionality of the reachable set turns out to be independent of the system, yet the fraction of Hilbert space lying close to it depends strongly on the choice of control Hamiltonians. Strikingly, for sufficiently random controls and long enough evolution times, almost every state can become approximately reachable, even with the fewest generators that permit full controllability with time-dependent couplings. Autonomous control can approach the expressivity of time-dependent control, at the cost of longer evolution times.

summaries.en: The paper studies quantum state preparation using an autonomous (time-invariant) Hamiltonian, characterizing what states are reachable, providing analytical and numerical unreachability criteria, and showing that while the reachable-set dimension is system-independent, the fraction of Hilbert space it covers depends on the control Hamiltonians, with random controls and sufficiently long times enabling almost any state to be approximately reachable—approaching the expressivity of time-dependent control but requiring longer evolution times.
summaries.zh: 论文研究在哈密顿量随时间不变的“自主控制”条件下进行量子态制备，刻画可达态集合的性质，提出用于判定不可达的解析与数值标准，并发现虽然可达集合的维度与系统无关，但它覆盖的希尔伯特空间比例强烈依赖于所选控制哈密顿量；在控制项足够随机且演化时间足够长时，几乎所有态都能被近似地制备出来，从而在表达能力上接近时变控制，但代价是需要更长的演化时间。

title: Collective Superconducting-Qubit Interfaces for Microwave-to-Optical Quantum Transduction
abstract: Microwave-to-optical quantum transduction is essential for connecting superconducting quantum processors through optical networks. Mechanically mediated transducers, however, remain limited by weak electromechanical coupling, dissipation, and added noise. In this work, we study a transducer in which an ensemble of superconducting qubits couples collectively to a shared optomechanical resonator. For weak signals, we show that ensemble size and optical pump strength together set the conversion efficiency, added noise, and bandwidth, with pump heating limiting efficiency to a finite optimal pump strength. Near half excitation, the collective coupling grows nearly linearly with ensemble size, accelerating transfer of an excitation into the mechanics. We show that this speedup is offset by relaxation of the additional excited qubits, so the single-qubit coupling and lifetime still set the coherence requirement. Transferring exactly one excitation also requires an anharmonic mechanical mode, which an auxiliary qubit coupled to the mechanics can provide. In a lossless prescribed-Kerr benchmark with four qubits and $g_{\rm sm}/(2\pi)=3.81\,\mathrm{kHz}$, a mechanical anharmonicity of $100\,\mathrm{kHz}$ raises the final joint single-photon intracavity target probability from $19.6\%$ to $99.7\%$. Finally, we quantify the effects of decoherence, disorder, residual qubit--qubit interactions, and pump-induced qubit noise, finding that pair-dependent interactions reduce the optical retrieval efficiency from 58\% to 35\%. These results establish the coherence and selectivity requirements for collective quantum transduction.

summaries.en: The paper proposes and analyzes a collective superconducting-qubit optomechanical transducer for efficient microwave-to-optical quantum conversion, showing how ensemble size and pump strength determine efficiency, noise, and bandwidth while coherence constraints are still governed by single-qubit coupling/lifetime and exact single-excitation transfer requires mechanical anharmonicity.
summaries.zh: 论文提出并分析了一种基于集体耦合的超导量子比特-光机传感器，用于高效实现微波到光学的量子转换，并表明激发群体大小与泵浦强度共同决定效率、噪声与带宽，而精确单激发传递仍受单比特耦合/寿命的相干性约束且需要机械非谐性。

title: Symmetry classification of hyperfine rovibrational molecular phase space
abstract: Symmetry-based structures have advanced molecular spectroscopy and quantum information science, yet connections between these fields remain largely unexplored. We construct a phase space theory of a molecule by jointly treating rotational, vibrational, and nuclear-spin degrees of freedom as the quotient of orientations and normal coordinates by the molecule's point group. The various combinations of how these three degrees of freedom transform under symmetries organize a molecule's states into molecular species, and we show that each species is defined by a particular absolutely maximally entangled (AME) carrier state, or, for 45 species, by a two-dimensional space of them. Up to local unitaries and the order of the sectors, molecular species realize 21 AME states across 75 point groups: a product state, four maximally entangled pairs, and 16 genuinely tripartite states. A Fourier transform on the quotient relates orientation and angular-momentum descriptions while preserving these carrier states. We propose an example experimental protocol for preparing and driving symmetry-adapted bend states of $\mathrm{CaOCH_3}$.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Representation Theory (math.RT); Atomic Physics (physics.atom-ph); Chemical Physics (physics.chem-ph)

summaries.en: The paper develops a symmetry-quotient phase-space framework for hyperfine rovibrational molecules that classifies molecular species by absolutely maximally entangled carrier states and shows how a Fourier transform connects orientation and angular-momentum pictures while preserving those states, including a proposed experiment for preparing symmetry-adapted bend states of CaOCH3.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种基于分子点群对超精细转动-振动相空间进行商空间构建的方法，用以按对称变换组合对分子“物种”进行分类，并表明每个物种由特定的绝对最大纠缠（AME）载体态（或在若干情形下由其二维子空间）刻画，同时证明商空间下的傅里叶变换能在不改变载体态的情况下把取向与角动量描述联系起来，并给出一个制备CaOCH3对称适配弯曲态的实验方案。

title: Experimental constraints on gauge hidden-variable models in Bell tests
abstract: Quantum mechanics assigns identical statistics to measurement procedures that realize the same final effect, irrespective of the transformations used to reach it. We test this operational equivalence with polarization-entangled photons by implementing one of Bob's analyzer settings either directly or through closed wave-plate trajectories $C_\gamma$ calibrated to produce the same measurement operator. Motivated by ontological descriptions in which a hidden frame is transported between contexts, we formulate a local path-memory model and derive the mixed-context bound $|S_\gamma^{\rm mix}|\leq 2+2p_\gamma$. The quantity $p_\gamma$ is a coupling-dependent counterfactual mismatch probability: it bounds a contextual Bell expression, but neither generates nor predicts the quantum Bell correlation. We therefore test path memory through the observable difference between direct and looped implementations, using a no-signaling phenomenological response in which a hidden holonomy $\delta_\gamma$ modifies one correlation term in $S_\gamma^{\rm mix}$. The direct reference violates the Bell inequality, while the looped mixed-context curves remain indistinguishable from it within the experimental precision. Our results support the quantum equivalence of calibrated measurement implementations and constrain path-sensitive hidden-variable extensions that predict an observable memory of the optical history.

summaries.en: The paper experimentally tests the quantum operational equivalence of Bell-test measurement implementations by comparing direct and looped polarization-analyzer settings and finds that, while the direct setup violates the Bell inequality, the looped mixed-context behavior matches it within precision, thereby constraining local path-memory gauge hidden-variable models that would otherwise predict observable optical-history dependence.
summaries.zh: 论文通过对比直接与闭合波片轨迹实现的极化贝尔检验测量设置，实验性检验量子力学关于“操作等价”的预测：直接实现可违反贝尔不等式，而考虑混合上下文的闭合实现曲线在实验精度内与之不可区分，从而约束了会预测可观测光学历史记忆的局域路径记忆规范隐变量模型。

title: High-rate low-distance color codes
abstract: Experimental implementations of two-dimensional color codes encoding a single logical qubit have surpassed the fidelity of physical qubits. A natural next step is to investigate higher-rate codes that encode multiple logical qubits. Here we propose small, high-rate 2D color codes for this purpose. We design distance-$3$ codes with encoding rates up to $1/3$ and distance-$4$ codes with encoding rates up to $1/4$. We prove that these rates are optimal for color codes with only color boundaries on surfaces with non-negative Euler characteristic. We benchmark the codes by simulating Steane-style error correction with real-time feedback and no post-selection in a linear trapped-ion chain model with all-to-all connectivity. The two best-performing codes have parameters $[[20,4,4]]$ and $[[16,4,4]]$ and achieve break-even at two-qubit gate infidelities of $0.22\%$ and $0.26\%$, respectively. These results match the performance of Shor-style error correction with bivariate bicycle codes that use weight-$5$ measurements.

summaries.en: The paper proposes small, high-rate 2D color codes encoding multiple logical qubits, proves their optimal encoding rates for suitable planar topologies, and benchmarks them in a trapped-ion model showing best-performing [[20,4,4]] and [[16,4,4]] codes with break-even two-qubit gate infidelities of 0.
summaries.zh: 本文提出用于编码多个逻辑比特的小型高比特率二维彩色码，证明其在特定平面拓扑下的最优编码率，并在受限于线性陷阱离子链的仿真模型中进行基准测试，结果表明表现最佳的 [[20,4,4]] 与 [[16,4,4]] 码在双比特门保本失真分别达到0.

title: Compute Before You Digitize: ADC-less Mixed-Signal Processing for Scalable Cryogenic Qubit Readout
abstract: We introduce DIRAC, an ADC-less in-cryostat qubit readout architecture that uses analog computing to redraw the analog-digital boundary. Directly operating on the front-end's analog output, passive complex mixers perform the equivalent of digital demodulation, ping-pong active-RC integrators average their outputs into down-sampled per-qubit traces, and a time-domain stage digitizes them, eliminating Nyquist-rate ADCs. A TX-RX co-design derives the mixers' local oscillators from the readout transmitter's baseband rather than per-tone PLLs. A per-line calibration flow trains the matched filter jointly with the neural network, improving fidelity and enabling low-bit-width, low-voltage digital processing. Designed in 22 nm FD-SOI and evaluated at 4 K on 1.12M experimental shots, DIRAC matches the fidelity of a floating-point (FP32) digital pipeline for readout windows down to 750 ns, at 31.6$\times$ and 238$\times$ lower energy than the fixed-point (FxP) and FP32 pipelines. It cuts the total 4 K power per physical qubit by 50.4% and 68.6% relative to FxP and room-temperature flex cables, respectively. At a fixed logical-qubit count and 4 K budget, this yields, against FxP, a code distance larger by 2 to 6 and a 1.6-7.3$\times$ (Willow) and 4.9-204$\times$ (SI1000, $p = 10^{-3}$) lower logical error rate.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Hardware Architecture (cs.AR); Emerging Technologies (cs.ET); Signal Processing (eess.SP)

summaries.en: The paper presents DIRAC, an ADC-less cryogenic qubit readout architecture that uses analog mixing and ping-pong integration to perform demodulation and averaging before time-domain digitization, enabling scalable low-energy digital processing matched to an FP32 baseline while improving error-rate and code-distance tradeoffs via joint calibration with a matched filter plus neural network on 1.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了DIRAC，这是一种无ADC的低温量子比特读出架构，通过模拟混频与“乒乓”积分在时域采样前完成等效解调与平均，从而在4 K、1.

title: QCCDCert: Formally Verified Compilation for QCCD Co-Design
abstract: Quantum charge-coupled device (QCCD) architectures enable scalable trapped-ion quantum computing by dynamically shuttling ions between specialized processing and storage zones. A QCCD can be built with many trap sizes and layouts. Comparing them requires compiling every program under each design's transport, capacity and control constraints, and trusting the target code of each compilation. We present a co-design framework built on one Lean-verified compiler. The hardware description and its operating rules are compiler inputs, so a single theorem covers every candidate design: the target code of every compilation preserves its program's behavior and obeys the hardware rules. Across 75 benchmark programs of 11 to 130 qubits, the best design found takes 66% less modeled execution time on average than the worst design of equal capacity. An AI agent that proposes devices based on our compiler's checked results beats the fastest of these designs on 71 of 75 programs. Our verified compiler provably avoids the 11 defects that we report in three previous compilers. It scales to hundreds of qubits, compiling 512-qubit programs for a 38-trap device in 1 to 29 minutes.

summaries.en: The paper presents QCCDCert, a Lean-verified compiler-based co-design framework for QCCD trapped-ion architectures that formally guarantees behavioral preservation and hardware-rule compliance across candidate device designs, finding an optimal 66% faster (modeled) design on average over 75 benchmarks and scaling to 512-qubit programs in minutes while eliminating known compilation defects.
summaries.zh: 本文提出QCCDCert：一种基于Lean形式化验证编译器的QCCD器件协同设计框架，通过输入硬件描述与运行规则，针对所有候选QCCD设计给出单一可覆盖的定理，形式保证每次编译得到的目标代码既保持程序行为又满足硬件约束；在75个、规模11至130比特的基准程序上，最优设计相对同容量最差设计平均减少66%的建模执行时间，并且AI代理在75个中71个上超过这些设计的最快者，同时验证编译器可证明避免作者报告的三个既有编译器中的11处缺陷，并能将512比特程序在38个陷阱设备上1至29分钟内完成编译。

title: Singlet flags: using native entanglement to restore the circuit distance of shuttled qLDPC codes in silicon
abstract: High-rate quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes could greatly reduce the qubit count of silicon spin-qubit processors, but their checks are long-range and of high weight. Shuttling one ancilla electron through every data qubit of a check measures such checks, but a single fault on the ancilla spreads to several data qubits, so the circuit distance can fall far below the code distance. We make the mobile ancilla one half of a spin singlet whose partner stays at home; a Bell measurement at the end of the check provides a flag for isolated bit-flip faults acquired during the walk. Using new distance-6 codes with check weights 8, 10 and 12, and exact circuit distances from two independent solvers, we show that without the flag the circuit distance falls as check weight grows, to 1 at weight 12, while with it every weight-8 and weight-10 code recovers circuit distance 5 or 6 and corrects as many faults as the code. For codes of distance 8 to 12 the flag raises the circuit distance by one to four, and the Gross code [[144,12,12]] rises from 7 to 10. In circuit-level simulations of shuttled spin qubits, the flag lowers logical error rates by typically 2-10x across bivariate-bicycle, circulant-permutation and surface codes, and the gain survives percent-level flag-readout errors and bit flips on the singlet's electrons. BP+OSD does not reach the full circuit distance of the flagged circuits, so our flagged logical error rates are upper bounds: decoding the same shots exactly raises the flag's gain on the distance-6 codes from 3-7x to 5-17x for the weight-6 BB code, and from 1-12x to 5-90x at weights 8 and 10 for p >= 2.5x10^-4.

summaries.en: The paper proposes using a mobile ancilla as half of an entangled spin singlet with an end-of-check Bell-measurement “flag” to confine shuttling-induced faults, thereby restoring much of the circuit distance and reducing logical error rates for shuttled qLDPC codes in silicon spin-qubit architectures.
summaries.zh: 本文提出将可移动的辅助比特做成自旋单态纠缠对的一半，并在每个校验结束时进行贝尔测量获得“标记”来限制穿梭过程中产生的故障，从而在硅自旋量子体系中的穿梭式 qLDPC 码里显著恢复电路距离并降低逻辑错误率。

title: Parisi Energy before Parisi Geometry in the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm
abstract: The fractured low-energy landscape of spin glasses presents a notorious barrier to optimization. While high-depth calculations indicate that the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) can approach the Parisi ground-state energy of the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick spin glass, how it does so remains elusive. Here, we treat the QAOA distribution as a statistical-physics object and probe its geometry directly in the thermodynamic limit. We draw two independent bitstrings from the same problem instance and couple them through their macroscopic similarity. We find that typical QAOA samples remain macroscopically uncorrelated, even as their sensitivity to this coupling grows with circuit depth $p$. By contrast, the low-energy tail shows a much stronger tendency to overlap and reveals a Parisi-like phase with the same critical behavior as the thermal spin-glass transition. The onset of this organization moves toward the typical output as the circuit deepens, consistent with the separation vanishing only as $p\to\infty$. Together, these findings suggest a route distinct from structure-exploiting classical algorithms and thermal sampling, one in which the QAOA approaches the Parisi energy before Parisi geometry becomes typical.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Disordered Systems and Neural Networks (cond-mat.dis-nn)

summaries.en: By modeling QAOA outputs as a thermodynamic object and analyzing overlaps between classically coupled samples in the thermodynamic limit, the paper finds that typical QAOA bitstrings stay macroscopically uncorrelated even as depth increases, while the low-energy tail exhibits a Parisi-like phase with spin-glass critical behavior whose onset shifts toward typical outputs only as p→∞.
summaries.zh: 通过在热力学极限中把QAOA输出视为热力学对象，并研究由相同实例耦合得到的样本之间的重叠，论文发现随电路深度增加典型QAOA比特串仍保持宏观非关联，但低能尾部会出现与自旋玻璃临界行为相同的Parisi样相，其出现起点仅在p→∞时才逐渐靠近典型输出。

title: Spectral Engineering of Charge Localization and Work Reliability in Collective Quantum Batteries
abstract: The performance of a quantum battery depends not only on how much energy it stores, but also on how rapidly useful charge can be restored after work extraction. We show how engineering the reservoir spectrum connects these properties in an interacting collective-spin battery. Interactions separate the Dicke transition frequencies, allowing frequency-selective pumping and loss to control where excitation accumulates and how populations move along the ladder. Analytical results relate the pump-to-loss ratio to charge localization, fluctuations, and extractable work. Two reservoirs producing the same mean charge can nevertheless exhibit markedly different localization and charging times. Under repeated extraction, finite-time recharging also generates correlations between successive work outputs. At matched mean work, these correlations can reverse the ordering of single-cycle and long-time fluctuations: a protocol with larger fluctuations in individual strokes can deliver more reliable accumulated work. An exact counting relation connects these statistics to net charging-energy transfer, while relaxation modes distinguish recovery of the stationary state from recovery of useful work. Finally, local dephasing redistributes population among collective-spin sectors, leading to an exact stationary symmetry-dilution law and a finite operating window for work extraction under a collective transverse controller.

summaries.en: The paper shows that in an interacting collective-spin quantum battery, reservoir spectral engineering via interaction-split transition frequencies enables frequency-selective pumping and loss to control excitation localization, charging dynamics, and pump-to-loss–dependent work fluctuations, including correlations across repeated work extraction and exact counting and symmetry-dilution laws under dephasing and transverse control.
summaries.zh: 本文表明，在相互作用的集体自旋量子电池中，通过利用相互作用分裂的跃迁频率进行储层谱工程，可实现频率选择性的抽运与损耗，从而调控激发的局域化、充电动力学以及由抽运/损耗比决定的功率波动；并进一步分析了重复抽取过程中的跨次功输出相关性，以及在去相干与横向集体控制下由精确计数关系和对称“稀释”定律给出的工作提取条件窗口。

title: Imaging chiral snake states in a qubit array with programmable gauge fields
abstract: Spatially varying magnetic fields steer charged particles along directed paths. Where a field reverses sign, particles follow snake-like orbits along the reversal line, in a direction set by both the field orientation and the sign of their energy. Transport measurements have detected such snake states, but imaging their dynamics in a reprogrammable field landscape remains challenging. Here we digitally simulate the Harper--Hofstadter model with programmable synthetic magnetic fields on a 49-qubit superconducting processor. In each Trotter step, every hopping term is one native fractional-iSWAP gate, and single-qubit $Z$ rotations set all 36 plaquette fluxes independently, without additional entangling gates. Uniform, random, and stepped flux landscapes reveal Aharonov--Bohm suppression of diagonal propagation, disorder-induced slowing, and magnetic reflection. At a field reversal, bonding and antibonding initial states, which carry opposite energy biases, propagate in opposite directions, and both directions reverse when the field is inverted. A symmetry analysis of these reversals yields a chiral displacement of nearly one lattice spacing after ten Trotter rounds, with symmetry-breaking residuals below 0.05 lattice spacings. Bond-resolved flux programming with site-resolved imaging thus provides a quantitative tool for synthetic gauge fields and a route to time-dependent gauge fields and interacting particles.

summaries.en: The paper digitally simulates the Harper–Hofstadter model with programmable synthetic magnetic fluxes on a 49-qubit superconducting processor to image and characterize chiral snake-state dynamics at field reversals using symmetry-resolved propagation measurements.
summaries.zh: 论文在49比特超导量子处理器上用可编程合成磁通来数字模拟Harper–Hofstadter模型，并通过对场反转处手性“蛇态”传播的对称性解析成像与表征其动力学过程。

title: General Noise Channels and Mid-Circuit Measurements for Pre-Trajectory Sampling with Batched Execution
abstract: Many studies of quantum protocols require fast sampling of large amounts of measurement data from noisy quantum circuits, such as for training machine-learning decoders for quantum error correction. Exact simulation of realistic noise is expensive, while stabilizer-based simulators are fast but approximate, for example through Pauli twirling, which generally alters the output statistics. Pre-trajectory sampling with batched execution (PTSBE) accelerates exact trajectory simulation by sampling noise before state evolution. This method requires the outcome probability of every stochastic event to be independent of the state, which excludes mid-circuit measurements and general Kraus channels. We present a generalization of PTSBE to measurement and Kraus operators without approximation. Each event is partially pre-sampled, while deferred outcomes are drawn during grouped execution via multinomial branching and cached-state reuse. We implement the method for GPUs as an extension of CUDA-Q. On distance-3 topological code memories under amplitude damping, it is up to 24x faster than conventional trajectory sampling in CUDA-Q. On 30-qubit random circuits with mid-circuit measurements, it is up to 83x faster and outperforms the near-Clifford simulator Clifft when more than about 25% of the gates are non-Clifford. With repeated sampling of each final state, its sampling rate per trajectory exceeds that of CUDA-Q by nearly five orders of magnitude. Our method also allows us to compare exact amplitude damping with its Pauli-twirled channel on a surface-code memory, revealing that twirling overestimates the detection rate by 21% and raises the logical error rate of a lookup decoder by 8%. This work makes exact, high-throughput simulation practical for general noisy circuits, from data generation for training decoders to studying measurement-based fault-tolerant protocols under realistic noise.

summaries.en: The paper generalizes pre-trajectory sampling with batched execution to exact simulation of arbitrary Kraus noise and mid-circuit measurements, enabling GPU-accelerated high-throughput trajectory sampling that achieves up to 24×–83× speedups over conventional methods and shows Pauli twirling can overestimate detection and logical error rates in surface-code settings.
summaries.zh: 本文将预轨迹采样并批量执行（PTSBE）推广到对任意Kraus噪声与中途测量的精确仿真，形成GPU加速的高吞吐轨迹采样方法，在拓扑码与含中途测量的随机电路上相对传统方案最高可提升24×–83×速度，并揭示Pauli抽样会使检测率与逻辑错误率被系统性高估。

title: Quantum Mpemba effect in a driven-dissipative atom-waveguide coupled system
abstract: The quantum Mpemba effect (QME) describes the counterintuitive phenomenon in which a more strongly perturbed quantum system relaxes toward its steady state faster than a less perturbed one. Here, we investigate the QME in a weakly driven-dissipative atomic array coupled to a one-dimensional chiral waveguide. Starting from the steady state, we introduce a local quench by resetting a single atom to its ground state and examine the subsequent relaxation dynamics. We find that quenching atoms near the array boundaries induces faster initial relaxation through enhanced coupling to superradiant modes and direct photon emission into the waveguide, giving rise to an edge-enhanced QME. Strong directional decay further amplifies this effect by promoting the spatial accumulation of superradiant modes near the preferred boundary, leading to a skin-enhanced QME. At later times, relaxation is increasingly governed by long-lived subradiant modes localized predominantly in the bulk of the array. By coupling two atomic arrays with different interparticle spacings, we further demonstrate an interface-induced QME, where quenching an atom near the interface makes the system relax more slowly at early times but approach its steady state faster at later times, owing to weak participation in both superradiant and subradiant modes. Our findings reveal how the spatial structure of collective decay modes and directional dissipation jointly govern anomalous quantum relaxation, offering potential routes toward accelerated steady-state preparation in waveguide QED systems.

summaries.en: The paper studies a quantum Mpemba effect in a weakly driven, dissipative atomic array coupled to a chiral one-dimensional waveguide, showing that local quenches near boundaries or interfaces accelerate or reshape relaxation via superradiant and subradiant mode distributions enhanced by directional decay.
summaries.zh: 本文在弱驱动、耗散的原子阵列耦合一维手性波导体系中研究量子墨佩巴效应，发现对边界或界面附近的局部淬灭会因超辐射与次辐射模的空间分布及定向耗散的增强而加速或改变弛豫过程。

title: Distinguishing Conserved Quantum Sectors via Measurement Record Features
abstract: Conservation laws partition the Hilbert space of a quantum system into invariant sectors that are often difficult to identify directly. Repeated measurements on an ancillary probe, however, generate a measurement record that provides information about the occupied sector. Here we develop a framework for identifying conserved sectors using a $(K+1)$-dimensional feature vector of record statistics, comprising the average outcome frequency and pair-outcome correlations up to $K$ measurement cycles apart. For fixed $K$, the feature vector can be evaluated at a cost linear in record length. In quantum non-demolition measurement models, the average outcome frequency suffices for accurate sector identification. For an interacting spin bath with nontrivial dynamics within each sector, incorporating temporal correlations between successive and more widely separated measurements into the record feature vector substantially improves classification fidelity. Our framework provides an efficient approach to conserved-sector identification and demonstrates the importance of temporal correlations in distinguishing the underlying sector dynamics.

summaries.en: The paper presents an efficient method to identify conserved Hilbert-space sectors by extracting a (K+1)-dimensional feature vector from an ancilla measurement record, showing that frequency statistics alone work for quantum non-demolition models but temporal (pair-outcome) correlations markedly improve sector classification when sector dynamics are nontrivial.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种从辅助探测器的测量记录中提取(K+1)维特征向量来高效识别守恒的希尔伯特空间扇区的方法，结果表明在量子非拆除测量模型中仅需平均结果频率即可准确分类，而在各扇区内存在非平凡相互作用动力学时，加入跨不同时距的时间相关（如配对结果相关）能显著提升分类保真度。

title: CCZ gate beyond the strong Rydberg-blockade regime
abstract: We present a protocol for implementing a controlled-controlled-Z (CCZ) gate on a neutral-atom platform, employing three individually addressable atoms confined in a linear array of optical tweezers and operating under finite Rydberg-Rydberg interaction (RRI). The protocol combines successive excitation of the Rydberg atoms with analytically determined pulses and uses two Rydberg levels to access opposite-sign interaction shifts. We show two different paths to get the conditional phase in the target atom: a pair of target pulses with opposite phases and a single detuned target pulse followed by a local phase correction. We derive analytical expressions for the time-integrated Rydberg populations to calculate the associated decay errors and also evaluate gate performance through master-equation simulations. Numerical comparisons with a fast Rydberg-antiblockade (RAB)-based CCZ protocol show improved gate performance at larger interatomic separations within the parameter regime considered. Monte Carlo sampling further quantifies the sensitivity to thermally induced position fluctuations. These results identify the tradeoffs between gate duration, Rydberg-state exposure, and interaction sensitivity, providing an analytically specified route to native three-qubit phase gates beyond the strong-blockade regime.

summaries.en: The paper proposes and analyzes a neutral-atom protocol to implement a CCZ gate using three individually addressed atoms in optical tweezers with finite Rydberg-Rydberg interactions, offering two target-phase accumulation methods (opposite-phase pulse pairs or a detuned pulse plus phase correction), deriving analytical Rydberg-population integrals for decay-error estimates, validating performance via master-equation and Monte Carlo simulations, and showing improved robustness over a fast Rydberg-antiblockade scheme at larger separations beyond the strong blockade regime.
summaries.zh: 本文提出并分析了一种用于在光镊中对三个可单独寻址的中性原子实现CCZ门的方案：在具有有限的Rydberg-Rydberg相互作用（RRI）的条件下，通过连续激发并结合解析脉冲、使用两种Rydberg能级获得相反符号的相互作用位移；门操作中给出两种在目标原子上获得条件相位的路径（相位相反的目标脉冲成对实现，或单个失谐目标脉冲后进行局域相位修正），并推导Rydberg人群的时间积分以估算衰减误差，同时用主方程仿真与蒙特卡洛采样评估热致位置波动的敏感性，结果表明在所考察参数范围内相较快速Rydberg反阻塞（RAB）方案在较大原子间距下具有更好的门性能，从而给出了在强阻塞之外实现原生三量子比特相位门的解析指定路径。

title: In-memory measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution
abstract: Quantum memories offer to significantly extend the performance of quantum networks, but their complexity and limited performance at telecommunication wavelengths have so far hindered practical deployment. We propose a new memory-assisted measurement device independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) protocol based on in-memory interference. Our approach leverages progress in atomic ensemble memories that enable the interference of a stationary matter qubit and a travelling photonic qubit inside a single quantum memory. We quantitatively evaluate the performance of this scheme against memoryless MDI-QKD and existing two-memory architectures, showing that it not only achieves superior secret key rates and surpasses the memoryless bound at substantially shorter distances, but also reduces hardware requirements by halving the number of memories and detectors. Our results further indicate that off resonant cascaded absorption (ORCA) memories are a particularly promising platform for implementing this protocol, and we outline a concrete design compatible with their capabilities. These findings demonstrate that in-memory interference provides a higher performance, and resource efficient route toward near term memory enhanced quantum secure communications.

summaries.en: The paper proposes an in-memory interference based, memory-assisted MDI-QKD protocol using atomic ensemble quantum memories, showing via quantitative analysis that it delivers higher secret key rates than memoryless MDI-QKD and two-memory architectures while reducing hardware by halving memories and detectors, with ORCA memories identified as a promising implementation platform through a compatible design.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种基于“存储器内干涉”的记忆增强测量设备无关量子密钥分配（MDI-QKD）新协议，利用原子系综量子存储器实现驻留物质量子比特与飞行光子量子比特在单个量子存储器内的干涉，并通过定量评估表明其保密密钥速率优于无记忆MDI-QKD及现有双存储器方案、且在显著更短距离上突破无记忆上限，同时通过减少一半存储器与探测器降低硬件需求；此外指出ORCA（失谐级联吸收）存储器是实现该协议的特别有前景平台，并给出了与其能力相匹配的具体设计。

title: QuFrame: Pauli Frame Tracking for Fault-Tolerant Quantum Control
abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computing requires continuous quantum error correction (QEC) to suppress physical noise. While Clifford-only workloads can defer corrections to software post-processing, universal computation breaks this paradigm: executing non-Clifford gates via magic-state gadgets introduces hard, real-time control-flow dependencies on error-corrected measurements. Consequently, the controller must extract syndromes, decode them, and update the Pauli frame in real time, closing the entire QEC loop within a strict $1\,\mu\text{s}$ cycle. However, prior proposals on Pauli frame tracking remain largely theoretical, leaving the microarchitectural bottlenecks of tracking, resolving, and synchronizing frame updates across distributed control pipelines unaddressed. To this end, we present QuFrame, a control microarchitecture for real-time Pauli frame tracking that closes the QEC loop within $1\,\mu\text{s}$ while sustaining QPU-rate throughput. By introducing QuFrameISA, we cleanly decouple instruction execution from continuous Pauli frame management. Execution is distributed across per-qubit Instruction Resolution Engines (IREs) that resolve instructions against the frame via a single table lookup, while a Pauli Frame Management Unit enables independent, lock-free concurrent commits. To strictly guarantee the $1\,\mu\text{s}$ deadline, QuFrame pairs an asynchronous primary decoder with an on-chip fallback decoder that resolves in $144\,\text{ns}$, natively reconciling divergent updates in hardware without degrading logical error rates.

summaries.en: The paper presents QuFrame, a control microarchitecture and ISA that enables real-time Pauli-frame tracking to close the full quantum error correction loop within a 1 μs cycle for fault-tolerant universal quantum control at QPU throughput by distributing frame-aware instruction resolution and using fast hardware fallbacks to reconcile concurrent frame updates.
summaries.zh: 本文提出QuFrame，一种用于故障容错通用量子控制的控制微架构与ISA，通过分布式帧感知指令解析与1 μs内的硬件级并发帧更新一致性回补机制，在保持QPU吞吐的同时实时完成Pauli帧跟踪并闭合量子误差校正回路。

title: Doppler effect on dual-downlink time-bin quantum key distribution and a proposed ephemeris-assisted witness-field correction
abstract: Time-bin entanglement is promising for satellite Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) due to its compatibility with telecom fiber networks, but its phase-sensitive measurements are vulnerable to Doppler effects induced by satellite motion. We present a spectral-temporal framework for time-bin-entangled photon pairs generated onboard a satellite via Spontaneous Parametric Down Conversion (SPDC) and distributed to two Optical Ground Stations (OGSs) over independent downlinks with distinct Doppler shifts. Each OGS is equipped with an Unbalanced Mach-Zehnder Interferometer (UMZI) used to perform Bennett-Brassard-Mermin 1992 (BBM92) entangled-photon QKD. In a simulated Low Earth Orbit (LEO) pass with matched 400 ps analyzer delays, the received time-bin separation changes by at most 8.8 fs per link, while the combined carrier phase shifts by about 38 rad, which primarily degrades phase-basis correlations. After zero-Doppler calibration, this phase separates into independent signal-and idler-link contributions, allowing each station to correct its link Doppler phase shift locally, without real-time phase exchange between the stations. We propose an ephemeris-assisted feed-forward architecture, in which an auxiliary interferometer analyzes a co-propagating classical witness field to reconstruct the local Doppler-induced phase, which a phase modulator then compensates on the quantum channel. In a noise-free model, a 1 Hz sample-and-hold correction rate keeps the phase-basis Quantum Bit Error Rate (QBER) below 2% and retains 93% of the ideal asymptotic key yield. After 18 accumulated passes, the corrected finite secret key reaches 95% of its ideal length, whereas relabeling the parity from the ephemeris without optical correction reaches only about 8%.

summaries.en: The paper develops a Doppler-aware spectral-temporal model for satellite time-bin entangled BBM92 QKD over two downlinks with different Doppler shifts, showing that Doppler mainly disrupts phase correlations and can be corrected locally after zero-Doppler calibration via an ephemeris-assisted witness-field feed-forward scheme that uses a classical co-propagating interferometric measurement to compensate quantum-channel phase, achieving low phase-basis QBER and near-ideal secret-key lengths under a noise-free model.
summaries.zh: 论文建立了一个面向卫星时间隙纠缠BBM92量子密钥分发的多下行链路多普勒效应光谱-时域模型，指出多普勒主要破坏相位相关性并可在零多普勒标定后实现各站点本地相位校正，所提方法通过辅助干涉仪分析与量子信道共传播的经典见证场并用它重建多普勒诱导相位，再由相位调制器对量子信道进行补偿，在无噪声模型下可将相位基QBER保持在较低水平并获得接近理想的秘密密钥长度。

title: Long-distance continuous variable entanglement distribution over deployed fibre
abstract: Continuous-variable (CV) entanglement offers deterministic generation and room-temperature coherent detection for quantum networks, but distributing it over deployed fibre has been hindered by the need to stabilise optical phase, polarisation, and timing at remote receivers. Here we demonstrate, to our knowledge, the first distribution of CV entanglement over deployed metropolitan fibre using independent coherent receivers. The two modes of a two-mode squeezed vacuum state are delivered to remote nodes through 23 km ($\approx 7$ dB loss) and 450 m ($\approx 1$ dB loss) deployed fibre links. Each node uses its own free-running laser and polarisation-diverse coherent receiver. Co-propagating pilot tones enable digital recovery of timing, phase and polarisation, while inter-mode correlations fix the quadrature alignment. We certify entanglement with a Simon-Duan value of $1.915\pm 0.013$, below the separability bound of 2 and a logarithmic negativity of $0.067\pm0.011$. By replacing optical stabilisation with digital reconstruction, our approach offers a practical route towards scalable CV quantum networks.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates the first distribution of continuous-variable entanglement over deployed metropolitan fibre using independent coherent receivers, delivering a two-mode squeezed vacuum through 23 km and 450 m links with free-running lasers and digital pilot-tone recovery of timing, phase and polarisation and quadrature alignment, certifying entanglement via a Simon–Duan value below the separability bound and a nonzero logarithmic negativity.
summaries.zh: 论文首次在已部署的城域光纤上实现连续变量纠缠分发，利用独立相干接收机将双模压缩真空态通过23 km与450 m链路传输，并借助共传播导频通过数字方式恢复时序、相位与偏振、同时通过模间相关校准象限，最终用Simon–Duan指标低于可分界限且对数负值为正来认证纠缠，从而为可扩展的CV量子网络提供可行路径。

title: Linear-mode photon counting performance and intrinsic dark current in HgCdTe APDs for quantum optical applications
abstract: The performance of HgCdTe APDs for single photon detection at T=80 K has been characterized using a hybrized Resistive Trans-Impedance Amplifier (RTIA) and a deported Capacitance Trans-impedance amplifier (CTIA). The single-photon detection capacity was characterized with the HgCdTe APDs operated in linear mode with high APD gain, M>400, and hybridized with the RTIA. The measurements revealed an external photon detection efficiency (PDE) of 42 % to 55 %, and a dark count rate (DCR) of 2.6 MHz to 17 MHz, for an amplitude threshold ranging from 2.5 to 4.5 times the rms noise of the amplifier. Taking into account the unity gain quantum efficiency, QE=63%, this corresponds to an internal PDE ranging from 66 % to 86 %. Using the deported CTIA, it was demonstrated that the high level of DCR is not the intrinsic limit of the APD technology. The CTIA approach enables direct measurement of the APD dark current, Idark, with gain-normalized dark current levels as low as Idark/M=10.9 fA at M = 450. This corresponds to a DCR of 150 Hz which is compatible with the requirements for most of the quantum photonics applications.

summaries.en: The paper characterizes HgCdTe avalanche photodiodes for single-photon detection at 80 K using RTIA and CTIA readouts, reporting external PDE of 42–55% and DCR of 2.
summaries.zh: 论文在80 K下用RTIA与去耦CTIA读出表征用于单光子探测的HgCdTe雪崩二极管，在线性高增益工作时测得外部PDE为42%到55%、DCR为2.

title: From BBM92 Measurements to Secure Keys: Challenges in a Practical Implementation
abstract: The protocol introduced by C. H. Bennett, G. Brassard and N. D. Mermin in 1992 (BBM92) is one of the most important and widely adopted quantum key distribution (QKD) protocols. As with any other QKD protocol, its practical security depends on satisfying the assumptions underlying its theoretical security proofs. Here, we examine two common implementations of BBM92: a conventional passive receiver and a time-multiplexed configuration that halves the number of detectors. We characterise the passive polarisation analysers common to both architectures and present experimental results obtained with the time-multiplexed receiver, employing a continuous-wave (CW) pumped spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) source of polarisation-entangled photon pairs and threshold detectors. We investigate the challenges encountered during post-processing when attempting to satisfy the requirements of existing security proofs and discuss the gap between theoretical security assumptions and the extraction of a provably secure cryptographic key.

summaries.en: The paper analyzes practical implementations of the BBM92 QKD protocol, comparing a passive receiver with a time-multiplexed design, characterizing shared polarization analyzers, presenting CW-SPDC experimental results with threshold detectors, and detailing post-processing challenges that prevent meeting security-proof assumptions and thus create a gap to obtaining provably secure keys.
summaries.zh: 论文分析了BBM92量子密钥分发协议的实际实现，比较了被动接收器与时间复用设计，表征了两者共享的偏振分析器，给出了基于CW-SPDC连续波泵浦偏振纠缠光子对与阈值探测器的实验结果，并讨论了在后处理阶段满足现有安全证明所需条件时遇到的困难，从而揭示了理论安全假设与提取可被证明安全的密钥之间的差距。

title: A Relativistic Quantum Mechanical Formulation of Wu-Shaknov Entanglements
abstract: It is suggested that a spontaneous formation of quantum mechanical entanglements does actually occur between spin, helicity and polarization states involved in creation-annihilation processes. A framework built up earlier that presumably affords a unified relativistic quantum mechanical description of free particle-antiparticle pairs of any spin is used to propose a comprehensive formulation of Wu-Shaknov entanglements. Explicit relationships between amplitudes and Born-like probabilities associated to incoming and outgoing states are obtained thereafter on the basis of certain theoretical assumptions. The behaviours of these relationships under the action of a dynamical group which is taken to supply observational correlations for different frames in spacetime are then specified. It appears that a modified version of some of the conventional conservation laws may afford a set of general selection rules for the formation of relativistic entanglements.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a relativistic quantum-mechanical framework in which Wu–Shaknov entanglements spontaneously arise between spin, helicity, and polarization in creation–annihilation processes, deriving relations between amplitudes and Born-like probabilities for in/out states and analyzing how they transform under a dynamical spacetime symmetry group, leading to modified conservation laws and general selection rules for forming relativistic entanglements.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种相对论性量子力学框架，认为在产生—湮灭过程中，宇称与偏振等自由度会自发在自旋、螺旋度和偏振态之间形成吴—沙克诺夫纠缠，并基于若干理论假设推导入射/出射态的振幅与类玻恩概率的关系，再在提供不同时空参考系观测关联的动力学群作用下分析其变换行为，最后指出通过修正的守恒定律可给出相对论性纠缠形成的普适选择规则。

title: No-Go Theorems for Ordered Universal Entanglement Purification
abstract: Entanglement purification is a fundamental tool for obtaining high-fidelity entangled states used in various quantum technologies. It aims to increase the fidelity of noisy shared entangled states with a fixed maximally entangled state through LOCC. In distributed quantum systems, such as networks employing quantum repeaters, limited memory, probabilistic entanglement generation, and unequal storage times can leave a finite collection of nonidentical pairs. Their states may remain incompletely characterized even when calibrated preparation and storage records establish their fidelity ordering. Recent work has investigated whether fidelity ordering permits nontrivial universal purification. A nontrivial universal $n$-to-1 protocol must, conditioned on success, never lower the highest input fidelity and strictly increase it for at least one allowed joint input. Although no-go results have been established for a restricted class of LOCC protocols, the corresponding question for general LOCC has remained unresolved. Here, we study ordered universal purification under separable operations. Specifically, for every fixed finite $n\ge2$, we prove that when independently prepared two-qubit pairs range over the full family of states above a fixed fidelity threshold $0\le F_*<1$, any separable success map that never lowers the highest input fidelity on the allowed ordered inputs must preserve that fidelity exactly whenever it succeeds. This excludes nontrivial universal LOCC purification even for arbitrarily high input fidelities, without imposing a positive lower bound on success probability. ...

summaries.en: The paper proves that for any fixed finite n≥2, under separable success operations, ordered universal entanglement purification that never decreases the highest allowed input fidelity must exactly preserve that fidelity upon success, thereby ruling out nontrivial universal LOCC purification for two-qubit pairs even at arbitrarily high fidelities (without requiring a lower bound on the success probability).
summaries.zh: 本文证明对任意固定有限n≥2，在允许的“按保真度排序”的有序通用纠缠纯化中，只要成功时的可分操作不会降低最高允许输入保真度，则在成功条件下该保真度必须被精确保持，从而排除了即使在任意高输入保真度下也能实现非平凡通用LOCC纠缠纯化的可能（且不要求成功概率有正下界）。

title: Number-correlated photon entanglement with a quantum memory interferometer
abstract: Strong photon-photon interactions are central to quantum optical technologies yet remain challenging to realise at the single-photon level. Here, we show how embedding a quantum memory within a Mach-Zehnder interferometer enables a coherent transformation that converts single-mode photon states into number-correlated entangled states. Using an off-resonant ladder-type atomic interaction, storage and retrieval within a quantum memory maps a single-photon excitation onto a pair of photons across distinct optical modes via a driving control field. Embedding this within an interferometer deterministically produces an effective transformation in the photon number basis: $\sum_n a_n |n\rangle \to \sum_n a_n |n\rangle |n\rangle$ without relying on conventional optical nonlinearities. Measurement of one mode enables photonic non-demolition detection, state preparation, and frequency conversion as applications of the same underlying transformation. These results establish quantum memories embedded within an interferometric architecture as a platform for measurement-induced photon-photon interactions and the generation of Gaussian and non-Gaussian entangled states.

summaries.en: The paper proposes and demonstrates that embedding an off-resonant quantum memory inside a Mach–Zehnder interferometer enables a coherent, deterministic number-basis transformation that turns single-mode photonic states into photon-number-correlated entangled states without relying on conventional optical nonlinearities, enabling applications such as non-demolition measurements and state preparation.
summaries.zh: 论文提出并实验证明：将具有离共振相互作用的量子存储器嵌入马赫-曾德尔干涉仪后，可以在不依赖传统光学非线性的情况下，实现对光子数基的相干且确定的变换，把单模光态转化为光子数相关纠缠态，并可用于无损测量、态制备等应用。

title: Instanton tunnelling as a verifiable benchmark for digital quantum simulation: circuit structure, classical simulability and hardware reproducibility
abstract: We use instanton-mediated tunnelling in the quartic double well as a benchmark for digital quantum simulation that is checkable against an exact answer at every step. The instanton enters through the classical analysis; the hardware tests the dynamics of the lattice model. A unary (single-excitation) encoding maps N lattice sites to N qubits, with the single-excitation dynamics as a reference that remains classically cheap at any N. For a second-order Trotter circuit with adjacent, equal-angle XX/YY pairs on each bond, we prove that the Schmidt rank across any cut is at most four at every gate boundary and at most two after each pair, independently of N. Matrix-product-state simulations of this gate list reproduce the exact splitting up to N = 48. For this bond-wise formula the admissible Trotter step shrinks roughly as N^-2, so one tunnelling period costs about N^3.3 two-qubit gates; a kinetic/potential splitting keeps the step near 0.065 up to N=128, so this scaling belongs to splitting the kinetic term bond by bond. At a coarser, separately bounded step we measure the full transfer at N=8 on two superconducting processors, recovering the lattice splitting to a few percent and its dependence on the barrier height, which at this resolution is set by the lattice rather than by the instanton. Over 9 repetitions, runs taken minutes apart agree to shot noise, while runs hours to weeks apart differ by up to 6.1%, also on a fixed set of qubits; with sessions as the sampling unit, the processors differ in the damping, while a difference in the splitting is not established. Normalising by the measured single-excitation population extends the usable depth about 4-fold but does not improve the splitting. A Gaussian start state, which needs no diagonalisation, reproduces the splitting of the eigenvector-based start to within 1.6 percentage points.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; High Energy Physics - Phenomenology (hep-ph); High Energy Physics - Theory (hep-th)

summaries.en: The paper proposes instanton-mediated tunnelling in a quartic double-well, simulated via a unary single-excitation lattice-to-qubits mapping, as a verifiable benchmark for digital quantum simulation, proving tight Schmidt-rank bounds for a specific second-order Trotter circuit, demonstrating classically efficient matrix-product-state simulation up to N=48, analyzing gate-count scaling for tunnelling periods, and validating hardware reproducibility on two superconducting processors where measured splittings match the exact and show shot-noise agreement within minutes but up to 6.
summaries.zh: 论文提出用四次双势阱中的瞬子诱导隧穿作为可逐步核验的数字量子模拟基准：通过一元（单激发）编码把格点映射到量子比特，并将单激发动力学作为始终可低代价的参考，针对某种二阶Trotter电路给出跨任意切割的施密特秩上界证明，使用MPS可在N=48内复现精确能级分裂并分析隧穿周期的门数标度，随后在两台超导处理器上对粗粒度步长测得N=8的完整跃迁并恢复分裂及其随势垒高度的依赖，同时评估长短时间运行的一致性与批次抽样差异，并测试了归一化与高斯初态等策略的效果。

title: On Reaction Depth and Fast Fault-Tolerant Boolean Logic
abstract: Reducing runtimes of quantum applications is critical for practical viability. On quantum computers, the runtime can depend both on the speed of quantum operations and on how often the program must wait for the classical coprocessor to determine adaptive operations. Some recent approaches to reducing this overhead have focused on minimizing the "reaction depth" of a computation, informally defined as the number of times the classical coprocessor must be consulted while running a quantum program. In this work, we formalize the notion of reaction depth. We find several subtleties in this theory. For example, we distinguish the reaction depth of a circuit from that of a circuit run, and show that the magic depth of a unitary can be higher than the reaction depth once compiled into Clifford computation and magic state injection. We then focus on the specific case of coherent Boolean logic, a common and expensive component in quantum algorithms. We use a natural gateset for fast operations with Low-Density Parity Check (LDPC) codes, which consists of homogeneous $Z$- and $X$-type Pauli Product Measurements (PPMs), alongside a supply of Toffoli states. We prove that, using this gateset, any Boolean arithmetic circuit can be implemented on a quantum computer with constant quantum depth and constant reaction depth, at the cost of exponential space and leaving some qubits "dirty". Using the same gateset we find two efficient AutoAND circuits that require only a Toffoli state and homogeneous PPMs. We then give efficient implementations of the quantum ripple-carry adder and quantum schoolbook multiplier, which require a low number of heterogeneous PPMs for uncomputation. We find implementations competitive with the state-of-the-art despite the restricted gateset.

summaries.en: The paper formalizes the concept of “reaction depth” in quantum computation and shows how, for coherent Boolean logic implemented with a restricted set of homogeneous Pauli product measurements and Toffoli states, arbitrary Boolean arithmetic circuits can be realized with constant quantum depth and constant reaction depth (at space and dirty-qubit costs), alongside efficient AutoAND, ripple-carry adder, and schoolbook multiplier constructions competitive with prior work.
summaries.zh: 本文形式化了量子计算中的“反应深度”概念，并表明：在仅使用齐次的Pauli乘积测量与Toffoli态的受限门集下，任意相干布尔算术电路都可在常数量子深度与常数反应深度内实现（但代价是指数级空间并需保留部分“脏”量子比特），同时给出仅需Toffoli态与齐次测量的高效AutoAND电路，以及需要较少异构测量用于反演的量子涟漪进位加法器与量子学校簿乘法器，其性能在该受限门集条件下具有竞争力。

title: The magical memory cost of entanglement spectrum compression
abstract: How much quantum memory is needed to faithfully retain the entanglement spectrum of a bipartite pure state after separating out Bell pairs through local unitaries? We derive the exact tradeoff between Bell-pair yield, residual memory, and reconstruction fidelity under local unitaries, defining an operational measure of entanglement-spectrum complexity. Smoothed entanglement spread bounds this memory cost from below, while diverging nonlocal magic forces unbounded memory at any fixed positive fidelity. Chaotic circuit dynamics exhibit a transient memory peak whose height increases with system size, followed by declining cost despite continued entropy growth. A large typical Haar-random state requires only an accuracy-dependent memory, whereas stationary fermionic Gaussian states retain a growing cost with size. In the circuits studied, the multiscale spectral structure associated with entanglement catalysis also has a practical consequence for matrix product state compression, yielding a multiplicative overhead not captured by the conventional entropy-based bond dimension estimate.

summaries.en: The paper derives an operational tradeoff for how much quantum memory is needed to compress and later reconstruct the entanglement spectrum of a bipartite pure state after locally extracting Bell pairs, showing bounds, instances of diverging (nonlocal magic–driven) memory, and system- and circuit-dependent behaviors including multiscale spectral effects that increase MPS compression cost beyond entropy-based bond-dimension estimates.
summaries.zh: 论文推导了在通过局部幺正分离出贝尔对后如何压缩并重建二部纯态的纠缠谱所需量子记忆的操作性权衡关系，给出下界与因“非局域魔法”导致的记忆发散情形，并分析随系统规模与电路动力学变化的记忆行为，最后发现与纠缠催化相关的多尺度谱结构会使MPS压缩出现超出基于熵的键维估计的乘性额外开销。

title: Squeezed Cooling and Lasing with Cold Atoms in Cavity-QED
abstract: A squeezed laser undergoes a lasing transition into a squeezed cavity mode, where stimulated emission generates a bright coherent field with a laser-like coherence time while maintaining one field quadrature below the vacuum noise level. Here we propose an optical implementation that needs neither a nonlinear crystal nor injected squeezed light, based on engineered interactions between ensembles of rubidium atoms and a squeezed cavity mode via cavity-assisted Raman transitions. A first ensemble cools the cavity into a squeezed vacuum, a mechanism we term squeezed cooling, yielding up to 9 dB in the intracavity field, surpassing the 3 dB limit of optical parametric oscillators. Tuned for output instead, it reaches up to 18 dB of output squeezing. Incoherently pumping a second ensemble drives a lasing transition into the squeezed mode, emitting a bright beam with long coherence time and noise below vacuum spanning a megahertz-wide band, away from the sharp phase-diffusion peak of excess noise at the carrier frequency, and robust to relaxation oscillations. We characterize lasing thresholds, superradiant emission, and linewidth narrowing, and identify the experimentally accessible regime where the system exhibits the defining features of a squeezed laser.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a cavity-QED scheme using engineered cavity-assisted Raman interactions with rubidium atom ensembles to realize a squeezed laser, producing up to 9 dB intracavity and 18 dB output squeezing via squeezed cooling and driving a lasing transition into the squeezed cavity mode with bright, long-coherence, sub-vacuum-noise emission over a megahertz bandwidth while avoiding excess-noise phase diffusion at the carrier, and it analyzes thresholds and linewidth behavior to identify an experimentally accessible regime of these features.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种基于腔量子电动力学的方案，通过工程化的腔辅助拉曼相互作用操控铷原子集群来实现挤压激光：先利用“挤压冷却”将腔冷却到挤压真空，可在腔内达到最高9 dB并超过光参量振荡器的3 dB极限；随后在调谐用于输出时可实现最高18 dB的输出挤压，并通过对第二个原子集群的非相干泵浦引发进入挤压腔模的受激振荡，获得带宽达兆赫且远离载频处尖锐相位弥散造成的过量噪声峰值的亮场长相干、真空以下噪声发射，同时对弛豫振荡具有鲁棒性，并对阈值、超辐射与线宽展宽/变窄进行表征以确定可实验实现的关键特性区域。

title: Shedding Light on Quantum Non-Classicality: Witnessing Wigner Negativity with Free Electrons
abstract: Certifying quantum non-classicality like Wigner negativity typically demands full optical state tomography. This work introduces a noise-resilient framework for witnessing optical Wigner negativity using phase-resolved quantum photon-induced near-field electron microscopy (QPINEM). By mapping electron coherences directly to symmetrically ordered optical characteristic functions within a coupling-limited phase-space region, the protocol bypasses full optical reconstruction. A post-measurement witness matrix is constructed via Bochner's theorem from recorded electron spectra, where negative eigenvalues certify non-classicality. To ensure reliability under realistic experimental conditions, a noise-aware selection procedure decouples discovery from statistical validation. Benchmarked across various optical preparations-including vacuum-Fock superpositions, odd cat states, and GKP states-the protocol provides a statistically bounded pathway for probing quantum features with free electrons.

summaries.en: The paper presents a noise-resilient protocol to witness optical Wigner negativity using phase-resolved QPINEM with free electrons by mapping electron coherences to optical characteristic functions within a limited phase-space, constructing a post-measurement witness matrix whose negative eigenvalues certify non-classicality, and validating the method across multiple nonclassical optical states while accounting for experimental noise.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种利用自由电子的相位分辨QPINEM来以抗噪方式见证光学Wigner负性的方案：通过在受限耦合相空间内把电子相干直接映射为对称有序的光学特征函数，并由记录到的电子谱利用Bochner定理构建见证矩阵，其负特征值即可证明非经典性，同时通过噪声感知的选择流程将发现与统计验证解耦，并在多种非经典光态（如真空-数态叠加、奇猫态和GKP态）上进行基准测试。

title: Dressed-State Quantum Information Processing Using a Multilayer Ion Trap Chip with an Integrated Radio Frequency Resonator
abstract: We present the experimental preparation of a radio frequency (RF)-dressed-state qubit, the coherent operation of a single RF-dressed qubit, and the selective readout of RF-dressed hyperfine states of $^{171}$Yb${^+}$ ions trapped using a novel microstructured ion trap chip. We demonstrate the individual addressing of RF-dressed-state qubits in a two-ion Coulomb crystal. To this end, we developed, manufactured, and characterized a trap chip specifcally designed for quantum information processing with RF-dressed-state qubits. The chip consists of multiple layers, one of which includes an integrated resonator that creates a gradient of the RF magnetic field amplitude along the axis of a linear ion crystal. This RF gradient enables the individual addressing of dressed qubit states as well as their coupling. We characterize the ion trap chip experimentally using the hyperfine states of the electronic ground state of laser cooled $^{171}$Yb${^+}$ ions and by applying a single, global, modulated RF field oscillating near 12.6 GHz that drives dressed-state resonances. We present a microfabricated multilayer ion trap chip specifically designed for quantum information processing based on dressed-state qubits. This ion trap chip consists of multiple layers, one of which includes an integrated radio frequency (RF) resonator, creating a gradient of the RF magnetic field amplitude that allows for individual qubit addressing and qubit-qubit coupling. We experimentally characterize this ion trap chip demonstrating dressed-qubit state preparation, coherent single dressed-qubit operation, and dressed-state-selective read-out using hyperfine states of the electronic ground state of $^{171}$Yb${^+}$. For this purpose, a global modulated RF driving field oscillating near 12.6 GHz is applied to the ions. In addition, we demonstrate individual addressing of dressed-state qubits in a two-ion Coulomb crystal.

summaries.en: The paper experimentally demonstrates radio-frequency–dressed-state qubit preparation, coherent single-qubit control, selective hyperfine-state readout, and individual qubit addressing in ^171Yb^+ using a microfabricated multilayer ion-trap chip with an integrated RF resonator that produces a magnetic-field-amplitude gradient for addressing and coupling.
summaries.zh: 论文通过在^171Yb^+中利用一款带集成射频谐振器的微结构多层离子阱芯片，实验实现了射频阻用途（RF-dressed）量子比特的制备、单比特相干操控、超精细态选择性读出以及两离子库仑晶体中的单独寻址，其中该谐振器产生的射频磁场幅度梯度用于实现寻址与耦合，并采用约12.

title: Sub-Doppler Cooling of Potassium-41 in a Hybrid Quadrupole-Octupole Symmetry Magneto-Optical Trap
abstract: Sub-Doppler cooling processes rely on the near-degeneracy of the Zeeman sub-levels of the atom. Effective sub-Doppler cooling is only achieved when the ac-Stark shift of the molasses light is significantly larger than the Zeeman shift. This condition is typically achieved by switching off all magnetic gradients, and using Helmholtz coils to cancel Earth's magnetic field. Another way to achieve a nearly zero magnetic field gradient is to superimpose a second pair of oppositely oriented quadrupole coils with a different spatial geometry. At the ideal current ratio, this creates an octupole-symmetry magnetic field for the atoms. The resulting octupole magnetic field has a gradient increasing quadratically from zero at the center. In this work, the effectiveness of sub-Doppler cooling and trapping using D2 and D1 light is evaluated in such a hybrid trap for $^{41}$K. The temperature, lifetime, and phase-space density of the atoms are measured. For both D2 and D1 light, the octupole MOT is found to have a longer lifetime, while maintaining a similar temperature to the zero-field case. D1 gray-molasses temperatures down to $3.8(1)~\mu$K and phase-space density up to $5.3(4)\times10^{-5}$ are measured for $14.3(1)\times10^6$ $^{41}$ atoms. The effectiveness of the hybrid quadrupole-octupole trap suggests the possibility of increasing the loading time for atoms into an optical dipole trap with active sub-Doppler cooling.

summaries.en: The paper studies sub-Doppler cooling of ⁴¹K in a hybrid quadrupole–octupole magneto-optical trap where a tailored octupole magnetic field suppresses Zeeman splittings, reporting that D2 and D1 light yield longer lifetimes with similar temperatures and achieving D1 gray-molasses temperatures as low as 3.
summaries.zh: 论文研究了在混合四极–八极磁场的⁴¹K 磁光阱中实现亚多普勒冷却的效果：通过构造八极磁场来抑制塞曼分裂，结果表明在D2与D1光下该装置寿命更长且温度与零场情况相近，使用D1灰莫拉斯可获得最低3.
